entry.title: New: Bill 28 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 6, ARTICLE 2, SECTION 6-12, OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO PROHIBITED HIGHWAYS FOR COMMERCIAL BICYCLE TOURS

Adds Old Māmalahoa Highway, from its intersection with Mauna Loa Street in Honokaʻa to 46-4265 Old Māmalahoa Highway at the Department of Water Supply water tank.

Latest action: Council: Bill 28 passes second & final reading - 04/02/25
